assets.detail: Variant A: compact low twin amber tongues, dense narrow smoke twisting into an S-shaped coil; smoke heavier at base and dissolves into a small upper curl.
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production sprite sheet for an existing low-resolution side-scrolling pixel game. Primary request: SIX sequential animation frames of a SMALL smouldering wreck fire with smoke, ONE variant per sheet. Arrange exactly 3 columns x 2 rows, equal square cells, no dividing lines or labels. Genuinely transparent background. Native design grid is 64x64 pixels per cell, nearest-neighbor pixel art displayed enlarged; all frames same scale and same fixed emitter near bottom-center. On the native grid, small amber-orange tongues of fire only about 5-8 pixels tall, about 8-12 pixels wide at base; dull gray-brown smoke rises about 30-40 pixels above it, 15-26 pixels wide, slowly curls up and right. Flames use amber/orange/deep rust with a small pale gold core. Smoke uses desaturated warm gray taupe/olive-brown, medium dark value, matching a dim steel and sand industrial night environment. Distinguish warm saturated flame pixels from muted gray smoke pixels; leave visible smoke root just above the small fire. Fine ragged animation changes across six frames but identical fixed root. Crisp chunky single-grid pixel shapes with sparse internal cluster shading. This is only a small isolated fire-and-smoke VFX, NOT a burning car, NOT a bonfire. No vehicle, ground, scenery, text, shadows, glow, blur, smooth gradients, anti-aliasing, white outline, starburst, large sparks, or baked checkerboard. Keep every effect within its cell with empty pixel margin, no cut-off edges. No scaling motion.
Variant A: compact low twin amber tongues, dense narrow smoke twisting into an S-shaped coil; smoke heavier at base and dissolves into a small upper curl.

assets.detail: Variant B: wider low smoulder with three uneven tiny orange flame tongues; softer broken round gray smoke puffs with a slight rightward lean, visibly distinct from a narrow smoke column.
